description: SRP-dominant GTO-class arc: two-body gravity plus cannonball SRP with cylindrical Earth shadow only (SRP is the sole perturbation). Perigee points at the epoch Sun so the arc sweeps through the shadow cylinder around apogee; one orbital period.

srp.pressure_convention: P(d) = (TSI/c) * (au/d)^2 with TSI = 1361 W/m^2 (IAU 2015 B3), c = 299792458 m/s, au = 149597870700 m; d = Sun->spacecraft distance; direction unit(r - r_sun)

shadow.rule: factor = 0 iff dot(r, sun_hat) < 0 and |r - dot(r, sun_hat) sun_hat| < radius, else 1

frames.provider: IAU-76/FK5, zero EOP (dUT1 = 0, no polar motion)

generator_integrator.sampling: t_eval on the fixed grid below

tolerance.method: 3 x (integrator sensitivity [rtol 1e-12 vs 1e-10 re-run] + ephemeris-swap sensitivity + bulge-apex convention sensitivity) + 1 m (or 1 mm/s) floor, rounded up to two significant figures; each term is the max delta over the sample grid, measured at generation time and recorded below

integrator_rtol_1e-9_max_delta.note: informational only — not part of the tolerance sum

ephemeris_swap.note: baseline re-integrated with the analytic Sun/Moon series the Rust stack implements (Meeus Ch. 25 Sun mirrored from ephemeris.rs on TT centuries, Vallado Alg 31 Moon) in place of ERFA epv00/moon98 — bounds the ephemeris-choice effect end to end

bulge_apex_convention.note: baseline re-integrated with the Harris-Priester bulge apex rotation applied about the GCRF +z axis instead of ITRF +z (zero when the arc has no drag)

shadow_crossings.note: 0<->1 transitions of the cylindrical shadow factor sampled every 10 s along the baseline trajectory; entry/exit times are accurate to the sampling resolution.

notes: initial state constructed from the epoch Sun direction (perigee radius 6878137 m sunward, apogee radius 42164000 m anti-Sun, velocity along z x sun_hat); the r0/v0 numbers above are the contract — the construction is descriptive only.
